name: Liminal Descent VR
summary: Dive into an endless maze of yellow halls, buzzing lights, and pure adrenaline. In this VR multiplayer experience, you’ll climb, vault, and parkour your way through shifting Backrooms levels while escaping strange entities lurking in the dark. Every corner feels unpredictable, every room feels alive, and every step pulls you deeper into the unknown.
